findings: The learner overview and summary identify 口 and 巴 but omit the supported pronunciation comparison that makes the phonetic analysis concrete. Add a brief cited explanation that 巴 matches one reconstructed Old Chinese reading of 吧 (*praː), while 吧 also has a second reconstruction (*pʰraː); these are reconstructions, not recorded ancient pronunciations. Keep the comparison on the 巴 component and its learner card. Evidence: X-f81175053c475d9d93dd, X-ec189aed5ee43a0268ad.
